summary: Explains roles as reusable bundles of tasks, handlers, templates and files; lamp_haproxy uses six roles, and most sites have common roles plus app-specific ones. Roles can take variables, dependencies and parameters.
questions: How should I organize my Ansible roles?
What goes into an Ansible role?

answer_card.title: Organizing roles
answer_card.answer_md: Roles package tasks, handlers, templates and files into reusable components. The example has six: `common`, `base-apache`, `db`, `haproxy`, `nagios`, `web`. Typically you have one or more common roles for all systems plus application-specific roles. Roles can have variables, dependencies and parameters.
